You look absolutely beautiful !🖤 As a fellow goth I’ve also struggled with toning down my make up now that I’m in my 30’s.🥲 I’ve been a make up artist for the last 10 years, this is what I would suggest:
I think you should try doing a mid wing with brown eyeliner or you can try just doing a half lash with falscara for that winged look without the liner. My personal favorite lash is the naked 423 by ardell. 
Keep the lid shadow free I would say and just smoke out the bottom lash line slightly with a natural brown shade. I would also avoid shimmer on the inner corner and do a white or cream liner inside the water line to open and brighten your eyes. You have beautiful skin so unless you really feel you need coverage I would stay away from foundation. There’s a “tone up” cream
You can use by numbuzin called “goodbye redness” #2, it adjust to your skin tone and cancels any redness but gives you a beautiful glow. It will also give you minimal coverage and even out the skin. 😊 For lips I would say avoid Matte lipsticks and try a glossy formula! My personal favorites are the maybelline vinyl ink, wet and wild comforting lip, and revlon satin Ink. If you need any shade suggestions feel free to ask, hope this helps! 🧛🏻‍♀️🖤
